Title: Cognitive Services Form Recognizer Name Changes

Body.Content:
Effective September 1, 2019, the meter names of Cognitive Services Form Recognizer Pre-built and Custom will change.

There won't be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on names.

See the table below for the changes.
